negative_snippets: Plumbing is very very bad. Cock did not work. W C seat was detached from pot. No response even after complaints. This is very bad experience.

Located in a  congested lane.towels were of poor quality.bed Sheet was not clean.does not have a inhouse kitchen hence  had to go out for coffee and breakfast all the 3 days. Gates are closed yuptill 8 am.

They don't provide toiletries and towels by default - you have to ask for it!

No drinking water facility in such a big hotel! You have to buy water bottles from them.

The person in charge at night is very rude and unprofessional. The rooms do not have very good finish and smell. You can find big spider webs in some places. The TV is much smaller than what it looks in photos.

There were some other issues which I am not remembering right now - that is why the 2 rating. I would have given, may be 3 stars, if the hotel was not so costly. The hotel and location don't justify the price.
